name: app-fintech-web-dashboard-soft-blue-glass
title: Fintech web dashboards with blurred blue-grey glass headers
whatItIs: Two overlapping desktop dashboards on white, each a pale blue-grey glass surface with a deep blue blurred cloud at the top. Panels hold a monthly limit progress bar, a transactions table, a large gradient credit card with quick actions, a wallet balance with cash-flow bars and upcoming payments.
whatItMeans: Calm and trustworthy; the blur cloud adds mood without adding noise.
techniques: Place a soft blue blur cloud at the top of the window as a header background.
Stack cards with subtle borders and shadows on a pale glass surface.
Use one hatched bar to highlight the selected month in a chart.
Show a large gradient credit card as a hero.

vocabulary.definition: A translucent pale panel with blur.
A striped fill marking the active data bar.
A large card graphic in a finance UI.
Two UI screens staggered in a presentation.
